description: Run an aggregation against a MongoDB database

connectionId.description: The connection to run the operation against. Use the id returned by one of the connect tools.

pipeline.description: An array of aggregation stages to execute. The first stage must be a database-level aggregation stage (one of `$changeStream`, `$currentOp`, `$documents`, `$listLocalSessions`, `$queryStats`). https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/mql/aggregation-stages/#db.aggregate---stages

responseBytesLimit.description: The maximum number of bytes to return in the response. This value is capped by the server's configured maximum and cannot be exceeded.

name: aggregate-db

aggResultsCount.description: The total number of documents returned by the aggregation pipeline

appliedLimits.description: The limits applied to the aggregation pipeline

documents.description: The documents returned by the aggregation pipeline
